items.title: JWST may have found where heavy black hole seeds formed
items.summary: Astrophysicists think that the supermassive black holes (SMBH) we see in the modern universe are the result of a long, drawn-out process. That process is referred to as the hierarchical black hole mergers framework. It explains how some SMBHs can reach such staggering masses. Some of the most massive appear to have billions of solar masses.

The JWST may have found the ancient sources of IMBH heavy seeds: young massive clusters in the high-redshift Universe.

items.title: This Ancient Meteorite Hints at Mars' Warm, Wet Past
items.summary: Ancient Martian meteorites are like time-capsules from the planet's past. They're delivered to us by impacts that launch them into space, where some of them find their way to Earth. One recently discovered meteorite found in the Sahara desert adds weight to the idea that Mars was once warm and wet, and possibly habitable.
items.topic_title: This Ancient Meteorite Hints at Mars' Warm, Wet Past

items.zh_full: 德雷克方程（Drake equation）自1959年由弗兰克·德雷克（Frank Drake）提出以来，至今已有65年历史。该方程旨在估算银河系中可能与我们进行通信的地外文明数量，其形式为N = R* × fp × ne × fl × fi × fc × L，其中各项分别代表恒星形成率、拥有行星的恒星比例、每个恒星系统中宜居行星数量、宜居行星上出现生命的概率、生命演化出智慧文明的概率、智慧文明发展出通信技术的概率以及文明存在时间。专栏作家Leah Crane指出，尽管方程中的许多参数至今仍不确定，但德雷克方程的重要性不仅在于其估算结果，更在于它体现了科学猜测（scientific guessing）的价值——即通过合理的假设和近似，将未知问题转化为可讨论、可检验的框架。这种“猜测”并非随意臆断，而是科学方法的核心组成部分，它鼓励科学家在信息不完整时仍能提出可证伪的假说，并推动后续观测与研究。因此，德雷克方程不仅是一个关于外星生命的工具，也是科学思维方法的一个经典范例。
